Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT și Dezvoltare de software
We are looking for Associate and Mid-Level Angular Developers to join our teams at Perficient Cluj-Napoca.
 As an Angular Developer on this project, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the user interface that supports our client's diagnostic devices. You will create modern, scalable, and user-friendly applications that enable healthcare professionals to interact efficiently with complex diagnostic systems. You will work closely with backend developers and hardware teams to ensure seamless integration between the user interface, software services, and device functionality.
 Responsibilities: 
Analyze future features and propose technical solutions.
Develop and maintain web applications using Angular.
Implement new features while ensuring the stability and maintainability of the existing solution.
Design, build, and document new UI functionalities and components.
Create responsive and user-friendly interfaces following modern development practices.
Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs and backend services.
Collaborate with backend and hardware teams to ensure smooth end-to-end system functionality.
Manage application state, performance, and code quality to deliver reliable user experiences.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical improvements and best practices.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code that meets industry standards.
Support troubleshooting, debugging, and continuous improvement activities.
 Technical Stack 
Angular
TypeScript
RxJS
HTML5
CSS3 / SCSS
Angular Material
REST APIs
Electron (desktop applications)
Docker
 Nice to Have: 
Java
RabbitMQ
PostgreSQL
Linux
 Education
 Bachelor of Science or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, or a related field.
